purpose: Reconcile the existing bounded replacement proposal with two confirmed reachable receiving-source blockers before replacement machinery or gameplay is admitted.

original_documents_preserved.precedence_if_accepted: This supplements only the prerequisite descriptions in sections2,3,4 and6 of the original replacement proposal. All other design, evaluation order, execution, rejection and stopping provisions remain unchanged. Neither proposal is accepted merely by publication or a new HEAD.

confirmed_receiving_source.post_block_finding: After the final defender declares blockers, the inherited receiving handler retains that defender's priority instead of returning priority to the active player. Both frozen mains can attack and block; pilot avoidance cannot exclude the interaction.
confirmed_receiving_source.actor_boundary_finding: The inherited operational stack constructs EngineAiPlayerController with gameStateProvider returning environment.state, and passes the authoritative state directly to respondToDecision and chooseAction. The existing information rules require a qualified own/public boundary before this runner can supply admissible gameplay.
confirmed_receiving_source.no_gameplay_inference: These are implementation and evidence-integrity blockers, not losses, negative deck results or terminal experimental conclusions.

before_seed_free_replacement_machinery: Independently accept the original bounded replacement proposal together with this explicit prerequisite reconciliation, recording the exact proposal hashes and separate coordinator disposition.

Independently qualify the canonical command, post-resolution, post-cast and post-block repairs, retain their distinguishing and mandatory compatibility regressions, and identify the canonical actor capability and its exact accepted source. Preserve the original exact-deck AnyTarget qualification requirement.
Do not implement a competing Pest shared-engine or information-masking solution. Source compatibility must be reviewed before reusing each accepted canonical component.
proposed_prerequisite_reconciliation.c2_construction_delta: The permitted prospective C2 change set remains historical C plus canonical command repair, post-resolution and post-cast repairs, exact-deck AnyTarget requirements and specifically reviewed replacement bindings; it now also expressly requires the canonical post-block priority repair and canonical own/public actor integration. Pin an explicit minimal delta from a224ef0008a2b85e2c2c106df9959678782e765d. No moving-main alias, blanket source-diff exclusion, unrelated Spy/postboard card import, hardware change or strategic pilot retuning is authorized.
required_c2_receiving_qualification: Retain all original command-context, protected-source, calibrated Pest/Monster policy, interaction, replay, receipt authentication, no-clobber, attempt/init/action-journal, failure-preservation and current rules/legality gates.

Exercise post-block priority through real accepted actions with both an empty block declaration and actual blockers in reachable frozen-deck combat. Verify the active player receives priority after the final declaration, offered responses belong to the correct actor, and the same transitions survive serialization and replay. Retain the canonical component's mandatory compatibility coverage.

Route both pilots through the accepted canonical actor boundary. Qualify each reachable action and pending-decision surface of the exact frozen60s, including target, mana/payment, library/search/reorder, optional and combat choices that those lists can actually exercise. Do not exclude a reachable interaction because a pilot avoids it or engine support is absent.

Use distinguishing information fixtures: changes confined to unavailable opponent-hand or future-library information must not alter the actor-visible input or policy choice; information legitimately exposed to that actor and currently offered legal choices must remain usable. Bind the adapter, policy, offered-choice mapping and replay to the exact receiving source.

The existing frozen strategic profiles remain the intended pilots. Any canonical information-interface correction must be explicit and independently reviewed; failed equivalence or competence checks require prospective disposition rather than covert policy retuning. Freeze any additional bounded receiving fixture inventory before execution and give both pilots equivalent qualification opportunities.
Run mandatory broader integration at the final C2 acceptance boundary. Green component, card-inventory, broad CI or old gameplay artifacts cannot substitute for exact C2 receiving qualification.

proposed_prerequisite_reconciliation.a2_after_c2: A separate prospectively reviewed A2 must pin an already accepted immutable C2, exact vector/artifact, actor/pilot/engine/rules bindings, authenticated receipts and live ref/claim reconciliation. No self-referential source hash or locally invented acceptance receipt is sufficient.

This reconciliation creates none of those authorities.
